newsitem.title: UK: Brown to ease inflation without hurting industry.
newsitem.headline: Brown to ease inflation without hurting industry.

text.p: British Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Wednesday he will cut inflation without hurting industry.

"My goal...is to ease inflationary pressures without damage to industrial and exporting prospects and to do so in a way that is consistent with our long-term objective of high and stable growth and employment," he said in his first budget speech.
"In this way we can moderate the upward pressure on interest rates and on the exchange rates as well as further our objective of sustainable public finances.
He said the economy was unbalanced and said what worries manufacturers was that inflation would run out of control.
